name: roundhouse
description: Capture intent in the Roundhouse Depot, answer durable questions, and inspect work status.

interface.shortDescription: Send intent to the Depot and resolve material questions.
interface.longDescription: Substantial project and implementation requests become durable Depot items before execution. Roundhouse owns triage, human decisions, readiness, internal executor or Herdr selection, verification, and delivery; this plugin never exposes a direct execution bypass, and Remote Desktop Commander remains limited to transport, inspection, connectivity, bootstrap, and emergency repair.
defaultPrompt: Is anything in Roundhouse waiting on me?
What is the status of my Roundhouse work?
